description: This file defines the ScreenCache class, which manages caching of widget outputs associated with screen names in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to get, put, and remove widget outputs from the cache.

classes.name: ScreenCache
classes.description: A cache management class for storing and retrieving widget outputs associated with screen names in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ScreenCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with the type 'screen'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the GenericWidgetOutput associated with a given screen name and cache key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a GenericWidgetOutput in the cache for a specific screen name and cache key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes and returns the GenericWidgetOutput associated with a specific screen name and cache key, with verbose logging.
